# StatusPill

The one status vocabulary: seven statuses, each a pill with a glyph and a word, mapped from every backend enum through SongNodes.status().

`SongNodes.StatusPill` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.StatusPill />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.StatusPill"></x-import>
```

## Props (StatusPillProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `"ok" \| "fair" \| "warn" \| "bad" \| "info" \| "running" \| "idle"` | Design status; or pass `raw` and let SongNodes.status() map it. |
| `raw` | `string` | Raw backend enum (TaskStatus, ScraperStatus, ProxyStatus, EnrichmentStatus, CircuitState, health or save state). |
| `label` | `string` | Visible word; defaults to the mapped label ("Paused after errors"). |
| `outline` | `boolean` | Outline style for dense tables. |
| `size` | `"md" \| "lg"` | Larger size for page-level save state. |
